extraction.notes: Centerspace reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO subtotal, so affo fields are null. The FFO and Core FFO subtotals use the 'applicable to common shares and Units' (pre-Series D dividend) figures, $20,889 and $22,046; the diluted FFO ($21,049) and Core FFO ($22,206) that add back Series D preferred dividends are not used as totals. Diluted share count 18,102 (thousands) reproduces $1.16 FFO/share (21,049/18,102) and $1.23 Core FFO/share (22,206/18,102); the per-share figures use the diluted amounts. Impairment of real estate and severance lines show dashes for 3/31/2024 and are recorded as 0. 'Interest rate swap amortization' was classified as debt_cost_amortization (judgment call). 'Other miscellaneous items' is (gain) loss on investments and pursuit costs, recorded as 'other'. Recurring capex: the only disclosure is $209 per apartment home (same-store), a per-home figure, not a company total dollar amount; recorded as per_unit_only with amount 209 and not converted to dollars.
